headline: A 12 km moderate run at controlled HR follows yesterday's long effort, capping a level four-week block heading into taper territory.
confidence_reasons: Multiple data sources active in last 3 days
summary:
Today's run sits at a moderate pace and effort — nothing hard, and reasonable to see the day after a 21 km time-on-feet session. Nothing in it suggests fatigue accumulation; it reads as a durable base absorbing back-to-back load rather than straining under it. The strain:tolerance balance staying level confirms the four-week build topped out where it should, leaving you neither overreached nor detrained a month out from the crossing.

The through-line worth holding onto is aerobic efficiency: comparable-effort easy runs are settling at a lower HR than the prior period, and that trend has held through a block where volume rose materially and strength frequency more than doubled. That's the signal that matters more than any single session — the base is genuinely getting more economical, not just bigger.

Last night's short sleep after a longer-sleep night fits the wide night-to-night swing that's been present lately. On its own it doesn't change anything; it's worth naming only because longer efforts are likely to keep coming and the swings haven't settled.
watch_items: Whether pack-loaded running finally enters the schedule, since the general base is ready but the specific weighted demand still isn't trained.
Whether climbing per run starts trending toward sustained ascent rather than the rolling profiles logged so far.
Whether the short-sleep nights begin clustering as longer efforts continue, rather than alternating with long-sleep nights.

evidence_items.text: ▲ 4-week volume 190 km vs 126 km prior block (+51%)
▼ Easy-run HR averaging 145 bpm vs 153 bpm prior period (comparable-effort runs, 9 vs 8 runs)
▲ Zone 2: 205 min vs 180-240 min/week target (114% of minimum); grey zone (Z3+Z4): 7.1%
▬ Strain:tolerance ratio 0.99 (MAINTAINING) (strain 91, tolerance 92); sleep averaging 7h29m over the same period
